title: Skin Changer
featureUpdate:
[h2]In-run Appearance[/h2]
[list]
[*]During a run, open Appearance from the pause menu and click a visible character, monster, Ancient, companion, or the merchant in a shop. The panel opens on the opposite side of the selected target.
[*]Characters and monsters can hot-swap skins and adjust or drag their model and health bar; the player keeps those controls in shops. Ancients and merchants only show a skin selector. Osty's skin follows the Necrobinder, while its model and health bar remain independently adjustable.
[*]Monster intents and targeting reticles have independent scale and position controls, plus options to follow model scale and movement. The actual targeting hitbox stays aligned with the reticle.
[/list]
cardPriorityUpdate:
[h2]Card Skin Priorities[/h2]
[list]
[*]Each card category can enable multiple skin Mods and order their priority. For each card, the highest enabled source that provides it owns the complete presentation; lower entries only fill cards not provided above, and effects from multiple sources are never stacked onto the same card.
[*]The Card Compendium shows colored source tabs beside each card, so available sources and the currently selected source can be compared at a glance.
[/list]
limitations:
[h2]Limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Most mods that simply replace pictures, models, or animations should work. A skin may not appear or may only work partly if its mod also adds gameplay, uses its own settings, or builds the appearance with special code while the game is running.
[*]A skin may not be found automatically if its files are protected, packed in an unusual way, or use unusual names and folders.
[*]Skins with special models, skeletons, animations, materials, or visual effects may be misplaced, invisible, static, or look different between the Compendium and actual gameplay.
[*]Please keep Skin Changer first in the load order. Outdated skin mods, missing required mods, duplicate mod information, or conflicts between skin mods can also cause a skin to be missing or display incorrectly.
[*]Game and skin-mod updates may temporarily break compatibility. If you find a problem, please report the skin-mod name, what character, card, monster, or Ancient is affected, what went wrong, and attach the game log if possible.
[/list]
description:
Switch character, monster, card, Ancient scene, and merchant skins. An Ancient compendium is added to the Compendium so Ancient skins can be selected conveniently.

[h1]NO RESTART! SWITCH AND USE INSTANTLY![/h1]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switch character skins from character select
[*]Switch card skins by character or color in the card compendium, or select a skin for an individual card
[*]Switch monster skins in the monster compendium and adjust each monster-and-skin scale from 20% to 500%
[*]Use the added Ancient compendium to preview and switch Ancient scene skins
[*]Click the merchant through the in-run Appearance screen to hot-swap merchant skins in shops
[*]Apply selected resources immediately and save every selection automatically
[*]The mod interface follows the game language (the same 15 languages as the Workshop description)
[*]Isolate forced cosmetic patches so unselected skins cannot take over resources
[/list]

[h2]Important[/h2]
Supports the v0.107.1 main branch and v0.111.0 public beta.

Place this mod first in the load order so it can manage cosmetic resources consistently. If it is not first, the in-game warning can move it to the top and restart automatically.

This manager only controls skin mods that you have installed and enabled. It does not bundle any third-party skin assets.

[h2]Open Source[/h2]
https://github.com/gurio-wine/STS2-SkinChanger

[h2]Version[/h2]
0.9.76

This mod was developed with substantial assistance from GPT and DeepSeek. More feature requests and suggestions are welcome!
